decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Samples should include walling showing the proposed brick, mortar and type of pointing.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with in accordance with the approved details.
Condition : 4 - The premises shall be used for storage and for no other purpose.
Condition : 5 - New windows shall be of timber frame design and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with timber frame design.

Condition : 6 - The door to be placed in the northern elevation shall be of timber and shall be permanently retained.  No development shall take place until detailed drawings of the door to be used in the construction of the external northern elevation of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Restoration of stable building including rebuilding of masonry walls and pitched roof.
